initiative.title: Self Improvement Remediation Cycle
initiative.summary: Convert the measured self-improvement debt into real role, scribe, and runtime-asset evidence so the score can improve beyond the immature baseline.

taskset.summary: Burn down the first-cycle maturity blockers: scribe waiver debt, dormant monitored-role evidence, low-reuse runtime assets, and a follow-up measurable report.

tasks.title: Create real scribe evidence
tasks.goal: Create verifiable scribe claim/log evidence and only remove the scribe waiver if collaboration governance proves the evidence is sufficient.
tasks.scope: Use the existing claim lifecycle and waiver records. Do not delete the scribe waiver unless a real scribe-role claim/log artifact exists and collaboration_governance_gate no longer reports scribe waiver debt.
acceptance: A real scribe-role claim/log or equivalent governed evidence exists in runtime records.
The scribe waiver is either removed with passing evidence or explicitly retained with a new blocker record.
self_improvement_cycle.py assess reports scribe_state as known or explains why it remains blocked.

units.title: Prove scribe usage before waiver burn-down
units.context: The maturity report shows scribe_state unknown and waiver_debt 1. This unit should create real evidence rather than editing metrics directly.
units.scope: Create or route real scribe evidence through the existing lifecycle. Avoid synthetic evidence and do not weaken the governance gate.
steps: Inspect how collaboration_governance_gate detects scribe waiver debt.
Route a scribe-role evidence record through the claim/log path or document a blocker if the dispatcher cannot represent the role.
Remove or update the waiver only after the gate proves the evidence is sufficient.
acceptance: The scribe debt is measurably reduced or a concrete blocker is recorded.
No waiver is removed without a passing gate or explicit review decision.
The evidence survives git clean/reset because it is committed.
units.handoff: State whether scribe_state changed and cite the exact evidence/waiver decision.
units.stop_condition: Stop after scribe evidence is real and indexed, or after a blocker review explains why the waiver cannot yet be removed.

tasks.title: Route dormant monitored roles
tasks.goal: Route council, progress-scout, release-steward, reviewer, and skeptic into real review or council evidence so monitored role gaps decrease.
tasks.scope: Use product-native review/council/seminar/task-claim evidence. Do not mark roles as exercised from prose alone.
acceptance: At least three monitored role gaps are removed or converted into explicit blockers with evidence.
A review/council record states which roles were exercised and which remain missing.
self_improvement_cycle.py assess reports role_gaps lower than 6 or explains the blocker.

units.title: Create monitored-role evidence packet
units.context: The current maturity blockers include five monitored role gaps. This unit should route those roles through real governance records rather than changing thresholds.
units.scope: Create evidence for monitored roles using existing records and gates. Do not invent live dialogue or bypass role-monitor findings.
steps: Read the collaboration gate role-monitor logic and current policy.
Create review/council evidence that assigns or records the monitored roles honestly.
Run the gate and document remaining monitored role gaps.
acceptance: Role evidence is traceable to claim, review, council, or policy records.
The role_gaps metric decreases or a blocker review explains why it cannot.
The next cycle report can compare before/after role_gaps.
units.handoff: List each monitored role and its evidence path or blocker.
units.stop_condition: Stop after the role gap state is measurable and indexed.

tasks.title: Exercise or retire low-reuse runtime assets
tasks.goal: Reduce low-reuse runtime asset debt by exercising valuable assets in real workflows or deprecating assets that should no longer be kept.
tasks.scope: Use the runtime asset registry and usage gate. Do not game usage counts with dummy references.
acceptance: Low-reuse asset count decreases toward the target_next threshold.
Each changed asset has keep, exercise, modify, or deprecate rationale.
runtime_asset_usage.py --check and self_improvement_cycle.py assess reflect the new state.

units.title: Burn down runtime asset low-reuse debt
units.context: The maturity report shows low_reuse_assets 17 against target_next 8 and mature target 2. This unit should prioritize real workflow exercise or explicit lifecycle decisions.
units.scope: Review low-reuse assets and create real usage or lifecycle decisions. Keep unrelated registry refactors out of scope.
steps: Run runtime_asset_usage.py and rank low-reuse assets by owner value.
For each selected asset, either exercise it in a real workflow or document a lifecycle decision.
Update registry/docs only when the decision changes the durable contract.
acceptance: At least five low-reuse assets have real evidence or lifecycle decisions.
The asset_gaps or low_reuse_assets metric decreases, or a blocker review explains why not.
No asset is deprecated without owner-facing rationale.
units.handoff: Report asset_gaps and low_reuse_assets before/after plus changed evidence paths.
units.stop_condition: Stop after asset debt changes are measurable and indexed.

tasks.title: Publish remediation delta report
tasks.goal: Re-run the self-improvement report after role and asset remediation and state whether the persistent goal is mature, improving, or still active.
tasks.scope: Report the measured delta only after the remediation tasks land. Do not claim maturity unless gates pass.
acceptance: The report compares baseline 32/6/17 with current score, role_gaps, and asset_gaps.
The next-session pointer and status reflect the true persistent goal state.
If score remains below 65, another concrete remediation cycle is registered or explicitly queued.

units.title: Measure remediation delta and update handoff surfaces
units.context: The first cycle established a baseline but did not improve metrics. This unit decides whether remediation produced measurable improvement.
units.scope: Publish the delta and next state. Do not edit thresholds to make the result look better.
steps: Run assessment and report commands after remediation work is merged.
Compare score, role_gaps, asset_gaps, waiver_debt, and scribe_state against the first report.
Update status and next-session pointer with true goal state.
Register or queue the next cycle if the target_next threshold is not reached.
acceptance: A delta report exists and is indexed.
Goal state is truthful: mature, improving, or still active.
Verification commands prove report freshness.
units.handoff: State the before/after metrics and whether the persistent self-improvement goal remains open.
units.stop_condition: Stop after the delta report and handoff surfaces are committed.
